items.title: First meeting
items.embedding_text: I was hosting a (pride) party at Penn house when Dakota and I first met. I was running around setting up when Dakota asked 'could you just enjoy your own party?' I grinned, I was just happy he was there and that he asked. Out of the 500 people who were there he was one of the few I invited personally.

items.title: Characteristics
items.embedding_text: Dakota is a medical science liason in rare blood disorders. He is driven, outgoing and a great communicator. He's given a TED talk about living with hemophilia. Which I admire to no end.

items.title: Compatibility
items.embedding_text: Dakota is outgoing and a great communicator. He's the perfect compliment to my introversion and keeps me connected to friends and family.
